messages.body:
7 Synthplayer the Tinkerer (level 2, 19/19 HPs)
             Began as a Gnoll Forgewright on July 31, 2026.
             Quit the game on level 1 of the Dungeon on Sept 28, 2026.
             The game lasted 00:13:58 (447 turns).

  1.   900000 Synthone   HuFi-27 escaped with the Orb

  3.   700000 Synthone   DEWz-27 escaped with the Orb
